title: Magnets
label: Glow Records
description: Magnets marked a milestone in Ozee's early career: his first major collaboration, released on Glow Records in 2022. Built around soaring melodic hooks and a driving progressive house pulse, the track showed the sound Ozee had been shaping since 2018 could hold its own on bigger stages.
coverAlt: Ozee - Magnets cover artwork, 2022 collaboration with AN3M, Killerbot & Sasha Lucia on Glow Records
